    <h2>{`Choosing the right level`}</h2>

    <h3>{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="h3">{`log.w`}</inlineCode>{` when`}</h3>

    <h2>{`TAG naming`}</h2>
    <p>{`Every log call must include a TAG. TAGs identify the module or class emitting the log and are the primary filter in Kibana, Splunk, and the Navigator Log Data page.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Rules`}</h3>

      <li parentName="ol">{`Use the existing TAG constants from adjacent files — do not invent new formats.`}</li>
    </ol>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// ✅ correct
import {framework} from '../../Constants';
const TAG = framework + '-DisconnectedDataAdapter';

log.e(TAG, 'Load Error', e);
`}</code></pre>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// ❌ wrong — inline string, no consistency

A rename proposal is tracked in `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`maximo-disconnected-enablement/docs/log-tag-rename-proposals.md`}</inlineCode>{`. When adding new TAGs, use the proposed names from that document.`}</p>
